The '''dream snake''' was a [[dreambeast]] created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trinta]] by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. It was five-[[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, and black with glowing red teeth.
